page: Google Cloud Platform t2a-standard-8 is a general-purpose server powered by an 8-core Ampere Neoverse-N1 processor based on the 64-bit ARMv8 architecture. The server provides 8 physical cores operating at a fixed clock speed of 3.0 GHz with dedicated CPU core allocation and one thread per core. Memory capacity totals 32.0 GB, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Cache resources include 64 KB L1 data cache and 1.0 MB L2 cache per core, supplemented by a shared 32 MB L3 cache. Cryptographic hardware acceleration includes AES instructions, though x86-specific extensions such as AVX are not present. The system includes zero local SSD storage and features no discrete GPU hardware.

Benchmark testing reveals moderate multi-threaded compute capability and solid network-adjacent application handling. In stress-ng testing, the server yields a multi-core score of 14,472.4 and a single-core score of 1,812.89, both falling within the middle 50% benchmark tier. Software compilation using Clang scores 9,005.0 on Geekbench, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression reaches 38.61 GB/sec. Application benchmarks reflect consistent throughput, recording 10.91 million Redis SET operations per second, 5,611.0 PassMark database operations, and a static web serving speed of 10.09 GB/sec. Uncached memory read bandwidth reaches 87.42 GB/sec, while write bandwidth measures 47.24 GB/sec.

Performance tradeoffs emerge primarily in single-threaded tasks and specialized AI inference. Geekbench single-core (1,073.0), PassMark CPU (6,205.54), and single-threaded bzip3 decompression (8.58 GB/sec) score in the lower 25% percentile. Small 135M model LLM text generation is notably weak at 32.29 tokens per second. Qualitatively, the t2a-standard-8 offers efficient resource utilization for scale-out Arm architectures where predictable physical core allocation provides steady per-core performance without hyperthreading interference. The instance is suited for general purpose web applications, microservices, key-value stores like Redis, build systems, and general database hosting.
description: Google Cloud Platform t2a-standard-8 is an Arm-based general-purpose server featuring 8 dedicated physical Ampere Neoverse-N1 cores clocked at 3.0 GHz and 32.0 GB of memory. Operating on the ARMv8 architecture, each core executes a single thread with 64 KB L1d cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB L3 cache, backed by hardware AES encryption support. The server includes no attached local storage or GPU hardware. Benchmark results indicate average multi-threaded execution, shown by a stress-ng multi-core score of 14,472.4 and Geekbench multi-core score of 6,000.0, alongside steady Redis SET performance of 10.91 million operations per second and static web throughput of 10.09 GB/sec. However, single-core processing and LLM text generation remain weak to poor. With a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio, the t2a-standard-8 offers consistent resource density for general purpose workloads, static web serving, memory caching, and light database operations.
